# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, only the main branch and the latest release are supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| > 1.0.0 | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, please report them to the repository owner directly or send an email to the security team. You should receive a response within 48 hours. If the issue is confirmed, a patch will be released as soon as possible.
